[[File:Steven Lewis DecipherCon 1999.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Steven Lewis at DecipherCon 1999. Photo: Decipher.]]
'''Steven Lewis''' finished second at the [[1999 Decipher World Championship]], losing the final to [[Gary Carman]].<ref name="trando-iv12">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/iv12.htm Steven Lewis interview], [[Trandosite]] (29 September 2000). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041026204829/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/iv12.htm Internet Archive]</ref> He also won the [[2000 St. Louis Grand Slam]].<ref name="gs00" /> [[Trandosite]] interviewed him on 29 September 2000.

== Interviews ==

[[Trandosite]] interviewed Lewis on 29 September 2000. He talked about how he started playing, his approach to deckbuilding, his 1999 World Finals loss to [[Gary Carman]] and his partnership with [[Clint Hays]]. Full text: [[Steven Lewis Trandosite interview (transcript)]].<ref name="trando-iv12" />
